name: voyager-copy
description: Interview-first copywriting skills for Facebook ads, emails and newsletters, and landing pages. Asks the right questions for the goal, then writes copy that passes ad-policy and human-voice checks.

interface.shortDescription: Interview-first ad, email and landing page copy
interface.longDescription: Ask for Facebook ad copy, an email or newsletter, or a landing page, and the agent interviews you first. It asks the goal, audience, offer and format, follows up based on your answers, confirms a summary, then writes the copy using the matching frameworks, Meta ad policy checks and a human-voice linter.
defaultPrompt: Use $fb-ad-copy to write Facebook ad copy for my offer
Use $email-newsletter to write a newsletter for my list
Use $landing-page to write a landing page for my offer
